# @three-ws/agent-memory

> Persistent, embeddings-backed memory for agents. Store facts and entities, recall them semantically, and surface a working context — over the three.ws Memory engine.

@three-ws/agent-memory is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/agent-memory`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-memory/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/agent-memory/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/agent-memory/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-memory/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
